# Know your progress.  Understand your training.  See your next step.

TEAMGOLDUSA brings purposeful coaching, athlete-development tools and clear family communication to competitive swimming at Auburn Racquet & Fitness Club.

[Join TEAMGOLDUSA](https://teamgoldusa.com/sport/swimming/agegroup/join/) [View Team Calendar](https://teamgoldusa.com/sport/swimming/agegroup/calendar/) [Explore NCAA Pathway](https://teamgoldusa.com/sport/swimming/ncaa/)

What your swimmer gains

## Understand the work. See the progress. Plan what comes next.

Competitive swimming in Auburn, California, with resources that connect the swimmer’s goals, daily training and family planning. Explore the tools below to see how TEAMGOLDUSA supports development.

01

### Understand the training

[How we develop swimmers →](https://teamgoldusa.com/athletes/academy/)02

[Explore athlete progress tools →](https://teamgoldusa.com/athletes/)03

Swimming Pathways

## A clear next step at every stage.

Each pathway supports development, confidence, performance, and long-term opportunity.


[1 **Learn to Swim** \\
Water comfort, safety, body control, and foundational swimming skills.\\
Learn More →](https://teamgoldusa.com/sport/swimming/agegroup/pathways/#learn) [2 **Development** \\
Technique, confidence, fitness, and preparation for competitive training.\\
Learn More →](https://teamgoldusa.com/sport/swimming/agegroup/pathways/#development) [3 **Age Group** \\
Competitive development with skill, racing, teamwork, and meet planning.\\
Learn More →](https://teamgoldusa.com/sport/swimming/agegroup/pathways/#age-group) [4 **Senior** \\
High-performance preparation, advanced racing, and long-term progression.\\
Learn More →](https://teamgoldusa.com/sport/swimming/agegroup/pathways/#senior) [5 **College Swimming** \\
Academics, recruiting, eligibility, communication, and college decision-making.\\
Learn More →](https://teamgoldusa.com/sport/swimming/agegroup/pathways/#college)

Our Culture

## How we train matters.

TEAMGOLDUSA believes athletic excellence is built on character excellence.
Our culture is organized around the **CITADEL Framework**, a seven‑pillar model
that guides how athletes train, compete, lead, and serve others.


CITADEL

[Character](https://teamgoldusa.com/community/citadel/#character) [Integrity](https://teamgoldusa.com/community/citadel/#integrity) [Teamwork](https://teamgoldusa.com/community/citadel/#teamwork) [Accountability](https://teamgoldusa.com/community/citadel/#accountability) [Discipline](https://teamgoldusa.com/community/citadel/#discipline) [Excellence](https://teamgoldusa.com/community/citadel/#excellence) [Leadership](https://teamgoldusa.com/community/citadel/#leadership)

### Why CITADEL?

A citadel is a stronghold. At TEAMGOLDUSA, our strongest advantage is not a facility,
a budget, or a training set. It is our culture. Every athlete contributes to that culture
through daily choices, habits, and relationships. We believe character development and
athletic development should occur together.


### The TEAMGOLDUSA Standard

Courtesy • Courage • Compassion

## Welcome to Truckee Tahoe Swim Team

Truckee Tahoe Swim Team is a**year-round competitive USA Swimming team**. We are a**501(c)(3) non-profit club**, operated by a board of directors that meets monthly.

The team is a member of**Sierra Nevada Swimming**, the local governing body (LSC) under**USA Swimming**.

We’re proud to train at**6,000 feet elevation**, right in the heart of California’s beautiful**Sierra Nevada Mountains**.

[👉 **Click here to download and read the 2026–2027 Swim Season Handbook**](https://irp.cdn-website.com/85ecd3e1/files/uploaded/PDF+2026+-+2027+Handbook.pdf)

### Our Mission

## Our Mission

Our mission is to provide every member — regardless of ability — with the opportunity to grow both socially and athletically, without feeling lost or left behind.

### Community Access & Athlete Opportunity

Tahoe-Truckee Swim Team believes every athlete deserves the opportunity to participate, learn, and grow—regardless of financial circumstances.

Our[**Need-Based Scholarship Program**](https://irp.cdn-website.com/85ecd3e1/files/uploaded/TTST+Need-Based+Scholarship+Application.pdf)provides financial support to dedicated student-athletes who demonstrate a commitment to swimming, positive character, and personal growth both in and out of the pool.

﻿

**Interested in applying?** [**Download the TTST Need-Based Scholarship Application**](https://irp.cdn-website.com/85ecd3e1/files/uploaded/TTST+Need-Based+Scholarship+Application.pdf)and take the next step toward making competitive swimming more accessible for your family.

### Coaching

All of our coaches are certified members of USA Swimming and have access to the most comprehensive training and certification program for youth swimming coaches in the United States. We offer professional coaching for swimmers at all levels, from Novice to National, covering ages roughly 4 to 18 and a wide range of abilities.

Our team proudly supports a diverse group of athletes, from Olympic Trials qualifiers to beginners focusing on basic skill development.

We also welcome prospective swimmers to experience our program through free trial days. When a training group reaches capacity, free assessment days may be paused, and a waiting list will be started. We maintain separate waiting lists of up to 70 members for both the development levels and the Pre-Senior to National levels.

Swimmers entering our first level of the team must be able to safely swim 25 yards and must pass the facility swim test.

**TTST Swimmer Progression**

## TTST Practice Schedule

Weekday practices are held at the Truckee Community Pool:

📍 **10939 Truckee Way, Truckee, CA 96161**

[Click here to visit the Truckee Aquatics Center webpage.](https://www.truckeeswim.com/#)

During most of the season (school year schedule), practices run from**3:00 pm to 6:00 pm**.

**🏊‍♂️ Truckee Tahoe Swim Team — 2026–2027 Season Overview**

Our first practice of the 2026–2027 season will be**Tuesday, September 8, 2026**. The last practice of the season will be in late**July 2026**, after which the team takes its annual break during**August**.

During the school year (September–June), practices are held in the**afternoon between 3:00pm–6:00pm**. When school is out, practices move to the**morning**for about one month before the August break.

### TTUSD School Year Practice Schedule

### (September 8, 2026 – June 2027):

**Mini-Marlin - Offered in short seasonal sessions**

**Ages:** Approximately 5–9

**Days:** Monday–Thursday

**Time:** 4:50–5:40 PM

**Frequency:**2 days per week

Families should email:

or

with the two preferred practice days.

Days are flexible. This system allows the coaching staff to balance the number of swimmers attending each day. If a requested day becomes too full, coaches will work with families to find another option.

**LTC 1**

**Ages:** Approximately 5–10

**Days:** Monday–Thursday

**Time:** 4:50–5:45 PM

**Frequency:**2 days per week

Families should email their two preferred practice days to the coaching staff or registrar.

**LTC 2**

**Ages:** Approximately 8–12

**Days:** Monday–Thursday

**Time:** 4:50–5:55 PM

**Frequency:**2 days per week

Families should email their two preferred practice days to the coaching staff or registrar.

**LTC 3 — Pre-Senior**

**Ages:** Approximately ages 8 –12, generally ages 10 - 12 are most common.

**Days:** Monday–Friday

**Time:**3:30–4:40/5:00 PM

Swimmers do not have to attend all five days, but**more than two practices per week is strongly recommended**.

**Senior Team**

**Ages:** 12+

**Days:** Monday–Friday

**Time:** 3:00–4:40/5:00 PM

**Frequency:**5 days per week

Senior Team swimmers are expected to attend all five practices each week and communicate with coaches when a practice must be missed.

**Multi-Sport**

**Ages:** 12+

**Days:** Monday–Thursday

**Time:** Approximately 3:30–4:40 PM

**Frequency:**2 days per week

Hi All, Fall 2024 Truckee Tahoe Swim Team - Marlins swim meet schedule is as follows, and all events are ready for sign up by emailing cyrus@truckeeswim.org. I will be making group entries after the deadlines. If you miss a deadline you can sign up before the meet deadline on your own. Fall 2024: October 18 - 20: King of the Hill. All levels and ages of the team are welcome to email to enter this meet before September 20th. Please send in your day preferences if you plan on coming for part of the meet. This meet location has been changed to the NEW pool in Reno! It is now much closer to Truckee. November 9- 11: Folsom Classic. All age groups with time standards are welcome to enter. Please look at the time standards before deciding to enter. Enter this meet by emailing about King of the Hill before October 22nd. Generally speaking it will be for our swimmers that have competed in at least 3 or more meets. The facility is an outdoor pool in Folsom, CA. November 23-24: Fort Bragg Travel Meet. All levels and ages of the team are welcome to email to enter this meet before October 24th. This is a fun meet to take a road trip and travel to the north coast of California! The pool in the town of Fort Bragg is an indoor pool. The surrounding area is beautiful with great seafood. Accommodations are optional but the team has stayed at the Beach Inn hotel in the past. It is very nice. Coach Cyrus will be staying here this year. www.beachinn.com . Winter 2024 - 2025: January 17 - 19 in Carson City, NV. Sign up by December 19th before holidays. All Levels and Ages January 31st - February 2nd. Woodland, CA Senior Winter Championships for Qualified Senior Team Swimmers. Senior team qualified swimmers. February 7 - 9 in Minden, NV. Sign up as soon as we get back from break before January 9th. All levels and ages. Spring 2025: TBA Please remember that all swimmers need to be USA Swimming registered to practice and swim at meets. If you registered last year you will be valid through the end of December 2024, and you will need to renew for 2025. If you are new to the team you need to register ASAP and it will be valid through 12/31/2025. We utilize 2 racing options. TTST and Sierra Marlins. The choice is yours, but I do suggest more competitive and older swimmers to race for the Marlins as this will offer a chance to meet new swimmers and enter relays at meets we join forces with the Folsom Branch. Suggestions for TTST: Novice - Regional levels of our team.
